title_o: Mechanisms of Selective Attention in Generalized Anxiety Disorder

replications.quote: None of the findings reported by Yiend and colleagues (Experiment 1; 2015) were replicated in a student sample.

"No main effects for Group, F(2, 390) = .12, η²p = .001, or Valence of Face, F(2, 390) = .07, η²p < .000 were observed… no Group × Valence of Face interaction was observed, F(4, 390) = .02, η²p < .000."

effect.name: Faster disengagement from threatening faces in anxiety
